citation: FL AHCA BA Services Coverage Policy (Section 2.2): Educational and Vocational Exclusion
rationale: Medicaid prohibits billing ABA for educational tutoring or vocational training. If an academic or vocational target is performed independently without the presence of maladaptive behavior, it is no longer treating a core behavioral deficit and is unbillable.

ALL_OF: displaying an absence of maladaptive behavior

citation: FL AHCA BA Services Coverage Policy (Section 2.2): Custodial and Recreational Care Exclusion
rationale: Medicaid prohibits billing ABA for respite, babysitting, or purely recreational activities. Operating in a community or play environment completely independently, with no maladaptive behaviors, constitutes recreation/respite.

ALL_OF: displaying an absence of maladaptive behavior

citation: FL AHCA BA Services Coverage Policy (Section 2.2): Medical/Nursing Services Exclusion
rationale: ABA providers cannot bill for nursing or medical care. If a client is experiencing a severe acute medical event (e.g., active seizure, severe respiratory distress), active structured teaching must be suspended until they are stable.
